# Existing schema-10 index

These index files were generated by the unmodified canonical engine at
`225a6d5d7265c478a64d3a609a536d0deed433e7` (7.0.1, schema 10). They were recovered
verbatim from the shared-core work's preserved Git tree. They contain nine
synthetic device-related lines with stable keys `id:101`, `id:202`, `id:303`,
stored in the index, and distinct catalogue/generation order. No library data
or search implementation is copied here.

`expected-mcp.json` converts the independently captured canonical `expected.json`
in `otzaria_search_engine/rust/core/tests/fixtures/canonical-7.0.1` into the MCP
wire fields: `file_path` to official book ID, segment to line index, highlight
markup to `«…»`, and the documented optional-field rules. It was not generated
by running the migrated MCP. All result fields and their order are asserted
for 16 searches, with exact per-book counts and file-byte preservation after
the reader closes. The original generator, raw golden and regeneration steps
remain in the canonical engine repository.

Do not regenerate these files with the implementation being tested. The point
is to test an already-existing index produced before the shared-core change.
